name: Isler Güçler
s: Ahmet, Murat and Sadi are actors who dream of shooting a movie and present a documentary called 'Meslek Hikayeleri' in order to make money.

paragraphs.text: İşler Güçler is a Turkish comedy drama series which aired first on 28 June 2012 on Star TV and tells the story of three actors, with the motto Modern Muzip Yalanlar (modern wicked lies). The main actors are Ahmet Kural, Murat Cemcir and Sadi Celil Cengiz who are using their real names in the TV series.
